title: code_index.module_graph request
description: Roll the workspace import graph up from files to directories or modules. Edges come from explicit import statements only; same-module visibility and self-loops are excluded.

granularity.description: `dir` groups files by directory. `module` groups them by Swift target or Go package when the index knows one, else by the nearest directory holding a package manifest (Cargo.toml, package.json, pyproject.toml, Package.swift, ...), else by directory.

depth.description: Keep at most this many leading path segments of each node id, merging deeper nodes into their ancestor. Omit for no limit.

roots.description: Workspace-relative path prefixes. Files outside them are not nodes, and edges into them are dropped. Omit for the whole workspace.

include_external.description: List unresolved imports (third-party packages, standard libraries, and imports the resolver could not map) per node.

min_weight.description: Drop edges with fewer import links than this.
